findings.description: The condition no longer checks whether the question refers back to the conversation, so any weak standalone question is retried with the previous question's text appended.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the user asks about stall recovery, then asks an unrelated standalone question such as a cooking question, and retrieval for it is weak. Mechanism: should_abstain(chunks) is true and earlier_questions is non-empty, so the retry runs with the earlier question prepended, even though the removed refers_to_previous_turn gate existed to prevent exactly this. Impact: the model receives unrelated handbook context and can produce a misleading answer.

findings.description: earlier_questions now includes every prior user turn, including ones that got NO_CONTEXT_ANSWER, whereas the old code only used questions that were answered.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the previous user question was off-topic and got NO_CONTEXT_ANSWER, and the current follow-up is weak. Mechanism: the filter that excluded unanswered questions was removed, so that unanswered question is used as the retry context. Impact: retrieval is steered by a question the system already declined, which can yield off-topic chunks.
